Great question! When using Fresh for the first time, introduce it gradually over about a week. Start with 4/5 of your dog’s current food and 1/5 Fresh, then slowly increase the Fresh portion. If your dog is sensitive to dietary changes, take things even more slowly.

Fresh can be stored in the cupboard until serving, as it doesn’t need freezing or defrosting. Once opened, cover leftovers tightly, refrigerate them, and use within 2 days (no more than 48 hours) 🦋
